## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle (10卷) **Tiāntái-school commentary** on the *Śūraṃgama-sūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Língyào Quánzhāng** 靈耀全彰 [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80), abbot of the **Lèngyán jiǎngsì** 楞嚴講寺 in Jiāhé 嘉禾 (Jiāxīng, Zhèjiāng); the author identifies himself as *Zhù Jiāhé Lèngyán jiǎngsì Tiāntái bǐqiū Língyào shù* 住嘉禾楞嚴講寺天台比丘靈耀述. Preserved as **X15 no. 306** in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The work is the main book of which [KR6j0712](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0712) (科) and [KR6j0713](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0713) (大綱) are the structural outline and main-outline summary.

**Abstract**

The *Dìngjiě* is a substantial late-Kāngxī-period reaffirmation of the **Tiāntái-school exegetical orthodoxy** on the *Śūraṃgama-sūtra*, written in explicit opposition to the Wànlì-period commentator [交光真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BA%A4%E5%85%89%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91) Jiāoguāng Zhēnjiàn 交光真鑑's *Lèngyán jīng zhèngmài shū* ([KR6j0703](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0703)), which had attempted to dispense with the six consciousnesses (六識) and the three contemplations (三觀) as exegetical categories. Língyào restores the classical Tiāntái apparatus — the threefold structural division (*sānfēn fēnwén* 三分分文: 序 / 正宗 / 流通); the *sìxītán* 四悉檀 (four siddhāntas) for interpreting the *rúshì* 如是 incipit; the *yuèjiāo* 約教 system of doctrinal classification (Tripiṭaka / *tōng* / *bié* / *yuán*) — and uses it to read every section of the sūtra. The opening exegesis of the *rúshì wǒwén* 如是我聞 already shows the method: Língyào takes the formulaic incipit and gives it a layered Tiāntái-school exposition through *sìxītán* and *yuèjiāo*. Composition: Kāngxī 19 / 1680, contemporaneous with the *Dàgāng*.

The *Dìngjiě* is the principal eighteenth-century Tiāntái-school *Śūraṃgama* commentary and an important counterweight to the Chán/Xiánshǒu-leaning commentaries dominant in late-Míng Buddhism.
